rca of the issue: Bug: Public Access & Rules admin surface never displays. RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminOrion.jsx defines NAV_SECTIONS with {id:'public-rules', label:'Public Access & Rules'} (line 51). The SectionRouter at line 380 has branches for chat, briefing, actions, reports, alerts, approvals, support, moderation, realms, widgets, badges, settings, private-access, ai-usage, classic — but no branch for 'public-rules'. The router therefore falls through to the default `return <OraiDashboard .../>` (line 397). Confirmed at runtime: after clicking the sidebar entry (highlight applies), main pane still shows 'ORAi Chat' hero and Recent Activity, and [data-testid=orai-public-access] is absent (query returns null). Additional confirmation via `grep -rn OraiPublicAccess /app/frontend/src` — only its own definition file. Fix: (a) import OraiPublicAccess at top of AdminOrion.jsx, (b) add `if (section === 'public-rules') return <OraiPublicAccess />;` before the default return in SectionRouter.
